From the founders

Why we’re doing this.

A note from Mikey, Haakam and Adi, and a few photos from along the way.

AgentMail · San Francisco

We started AgentMail because we believe the internet is going to look fundamentally different in a world where AI agents can act on their own. We knew what the future was gonna look like.

We had the same bet when we started the company over a year ago in the dorms. We stared at 0’s for the longest time.

Eventually, everyone caught up.

We look for people who take ownership, care deeply about their craft, and don’t need permission to make things happen. We want you pushing us harder than we are ourselves.

You’ll have more responsibility than your title suggests. You’ll work on problems nobody has solved before. The world is shifting, and we’re the ones in the heart of SF seeing it first hand. Potentially with you.

We’re still early. There’s a lot we haven’t figured out, and a lot of work ahead of us.

If you’re excited by that, we’d like to meet you.

— Mikey, Haakam, Adi
